items.title: Custom management apps
items.description: Tools built around the way you work: clients, bookings, inventory or whatever you need, all in one place. No more spreadsheets that don’t talk to each other.

items.title: Gym management
items.description: Members, fees, schedules and class bookings from a single app. You focus on training and spend less time on paperwork.

items.title: Custom portfolio websites
items.description: A site that shows your work the way it deserves, designed from scratch with no templates. Ideal for creatives and professionals who want to stand out.

items.title: Simple WordPress websites
items.description: A simple, fast website you can update yourself. Perfect for getting online without the hassle.

items.title: SEO management
items.description: I help people find you on Google: technical review, content and your Google Business profile. More visits from people looking for exactly what you offer.

items.title: Apps for small businesses
items.description: I digitise your business processes with apps built for small teams: quotes, orders or tasks. Easy to use from day one.

projects.title: Recent work
projects.intro: Three projects built end to end: design, development and launch.

items.title: Graphic Designer Website
items.description: A portfolio for a graphic design studio in Barcelona, with its work and services in a fast website. The work comes first and the contact details are always within reach.
items.alt: Home page of the Tresdegé website, with the studio name set large on a blue background

items.title: Training platform
items.description: A web app for coaches: it keeps training plans and athlete follow-up in one place, on a phone or a computer.
items.alt: Sign-in screen of the training platform, with the form on the left and a photo of an athlete on the right

items.title: Athletics parents’ portal
items.description: A portal where athletes’ families check personal bests, competitions and their children’s sports profile, without digging through group chats.
items.access: Private access for families and coaches
items.alt: Sign-in screen of the athletics portal, with the athlete code field and an aerial photo of a track

interlude.text: You work directly with me, with no middlemen and no templates.
interlude.lead: We talk, I show you proposals and we refine them until the site does the job you need.

about.lead: I help people and businesses get a website that is clear, tidy and easy to use.
paragraphs: I focus on fixing confusing or careless websites, combining design, development and close attention to detail.
I mostly work with React, Firebase and WordPress, and I pick the tool for what each project needs, not the other way round.
